title.narrative: Building Resilience, Inclusiveness & Capacity of H

description.narrative: The project’s objective is to increase the capacity of Human Rights Defenders and their networks to influence human rights policies that will empower HRDs and improve the human rights situation in the country. It also responds to emerging human rights issues particularly challenges relating to the freedoms, safety and protection of HRDs. HRDNS produce four quarterly reports per year, comprising one thematic report every quarter. These reports will focus on human rights, specifically women and mining, land rights, LGBTI individuals, persons with disabilities (PWDs), Sexual and Gender-Based Violence, the security sector's response to public order management, and environmental and climate change.
